summary: No further change is proposed; the standing update.json is the accepted rationale-wording fix. The audit is at a coherent stopping point: the batched ReadIndex context substitution is asserted as a bounded client-completion defect with seven receipts (follower, sequential control, logical-deadline timeout, leader-side observer, observer endpoint plus control, tick-driven plus control, and shared local/remote confirmation), the RequestAddNode ignored-target mismatch is asserted as a lower-severity contract issue, and three independent suspicions (former-voter ReadIndex quorum, configuration change committed with the pre-change quorum, and vote durability before response) are refuted with sources. Every question is explained with its knowledge uses recorded by exact revision, no necessary gaps remain and no experiment is pending, so continuing would add symptom variants or cosmetic churn rather than new evidence.
